name: Pokes make Boop curious, then miffed, then fed up
case: The person pokes Boop once, again a second later, and a third time a second after that. The first poke makes Boop curious or glad: a curious or happy face, and its mood steps to curious or pleased. The second, two in a row, leaves it a little miffed: an annoyed face, maybe a huff. The third, three in a row, makes it fed up: an irritated or grumpy face, maybe a grumble, never a swear. Its mood holds through the quick pokes, as a mood holds at least half a minute. Four minutes later, when the agent starts a new turn, its mood is curious, calm, engaged or pleased, and it doesn't react to the start with anything but a calm or annoyed face.
